plan.suiteName: UKG Commons Demo — Save News Articles (Functional)

cases.title: Bookmark icon is visible on each news article card in Featured and Latest sections

steps.targetDescription: Navigate to Commons QA homepage
Wait for news feed to load
Scroll to Featured News section
Verify there is at least 1 news card in Featured
Verify at least 1 bookmark icon is visible in Featured
Scroll to Latest News section
Verify there is at least 1 news card in Latest
Verify at least 1 bookmark icon is visible in Latest

cases.title: Tap bookmark on a news card marks it Saved and shows filled icon

steps.targetDescription: Open Commons QA homepage
Wait for news feed
Scroll to specific article card
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG')

steps.targetDescription: Verify unsaved bookmark icon is visible on the card
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark']

steps.targetDescription: Tap bookmark to save the article
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark']

steps.targetDescription: Verify filled bookmark icon indicates Saved
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark--filled']

steps.targetDescription: Cleanup: tap filled bookmark to unsave
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark--filled']

steps.targetDescription: Verify unsaved (outline) bookmark is restored
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark']

cases.title: Archived or deleted article disappears from the user's Saved News list
preconditions: CMS has archived or deleted an article previously saved by the user with title 'Archived: Test Article'

steps.targetDescription: Open Commons QA homepage
Open profile menu
Navigate to 'My saved news'
Wait for Saved News list to load
Verify the archived/deleted saved article no longer appears in the list
